Use the `resource` keyword followed by the resource type string, then the resource label, such as `resource "aws_vpc" "main" { ... }`.
Inside each resource block, set arguments using key-value assignments, such as `cidr_block = "10.0.0.0/16"`.
For the S3 bucket resource, define `resource "aws_s3_bucket" "data"` with `bucket = "my-learning-bucket-2024"`.
